scope: Packet workload, metric, and manuscript evidence; targeted primary-source checks.
counting_note: Seven records describe six new technical documents plus P03, an alias of existing M12. Metadata rechecks are existing works, not additional sources.

sources.title: Congestion Control Requirements for Interactive Real-Time Media
sources.reading_depth: Introduction, requirements, and media-source characteristics in sections 1-3 inspected.
sources.supports: Deadline-sensitive interactive media, application-specific bandwidth, variable packet/frame behavior, and congestion response.
sources.does_not_support: A universal numeric Wi-Fi deadline or fixed video frame rate.

sources.title: RTP Payload Format for the Opus Speech and Audio Codec
sources.reading_depth: Selected codec, bitrate, packetization, and media-type ptime passages, including section 6.1.
sources.supports: 20 ms is the default preferred media duration per packet when ptime is unspecified.
sources.does_not_support: A universal 20 ms delivery deadline, fixed encoded size, or this simulator being an actual Opus codec.

sources.title: Identifiers for WebRTC's Statistics API
authors: W3C Web Real-Time Communications Working Group
sources.reading_depth: Rendered-frame freeze definition, playout statistics, discarded-packet and concealed-audio fields rechecked.
sources.supports: A defined rendered-frame freeze metric and separate loss, late-discard, and media counters.
sources.does_not_support: Calling a packet deadline miss a measured freeze or calling a simulation a human QoE measurement.
sources.deduplication_note: Same dated technical document as M12. No new BibTeX entry; cite M12 from bibliography.bib.

sources.title: RTP: A Transport Protocol for Real-Time Applications
sources.reading_depth: Section 6.4.1 reception reports, loss, source/arrival timestamps, and interarrival jitter inspected.
sources.supports: The RTP interarrival-jitter estimator and distinction between late packets and RTP-reported loss.
sources.does_not_support: Treating ordinary delay standard deviation as RFC-defined RTP jitter.

sources.title: Structure Your Article
sources.reading_depth: Title, abstract, authors, methodology, results, discussion, conclusion, and reference guidance inspected.
sources.supports: A clear research question, reproducible method, separated results and interpretation, and restrained conclusions.
sources.does_not_support: A claim that this draft satisfies a specific venue before its rules are selected and checked.

sources.title: Research Reproducibility
sources.reading_depth: Overview and IEEE Open Research Statement inspected.
sources.supports: Sharing detailed methods, code, data, and other research outputs.
sources.does_not_support: An assertion that the study has been independently reproduced.

sources.title: Submission Policies
sources.reading_depth: Guidelines for Artificial Intelligence Generated Text and adjacent reporting sections inspected on review date.
sources.supports: Disclosure of AI-generated content, including code, identifying the system, affected sections, and extent of use.
sources.does_not_support: An editing-only disclosure when code, analysis, or prose generation also occurred; invented human review or affiliation.
